title: Tet Holiday
description: A Vietnamese girl tells us about Tet with her family.
instructions: Read Hoa's text about Tet. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🎆 Hello! My name is Hoa and I live in Ha Noi. My favourite holiday is Tet, the Vietnamese New Year. It usually comes in January or February, and we have a week off school.

Before Tet, my family cleans the house from top to bottom. My dad paints the gate, and my mum buys flowers. We always have a peach blossom tree in our living room, which makes the house look beautiful.
On the last day of the year, my grandma and I make banh chung. It is a square cake made of rice, beans and pork, and we wrap it in green leaves. It cooks for about ten hours!
At midnight, we go to the lake to watch the fireworks. The sky is full of red, gold and green lights. My little brother is afraid of the noise, so he covers his ears.
On the first day of Tet, I wear my new red ao dai. We visit our grandparents first. Then we visit our neighbours and friends. Everybody says, 'Chuc mung nam moi!', which means 'Happy New Year!'
Adults give children small red envelopes with lucky money inside. Last year, I got a lot of money, and I saved it to buy a new bicycle. My brother has already spent his on sweets!
We must be careful during Tet. We don't sweep the floor on the first day, because we think we will sweep away good luck. We also try to smile and say kind words to everybody.
I love Tet because the whole family is together. If you ever come to Viet Nam in the spring, I hope you will see how we celebrate. I think you will love it, too!
